shows: Commander Keen 4 'GOODBYE GALAXY' intro in EGA 0Dh, CLIPPED AT ROW 64. The banner and planet are pixel-correct down to guest row 63 and every row below is black. MEASURED CAUSE: crtc_offset=0x20 (row pitch 64) and crtc_start=15360, against a fitted card of 19456 plane offsets -- (19456-15360)/64 = exactly 64 rows backed. The intro does NOT widen the Offset (Queue B4 predicted 0x40); it displays from a high start, so 200 rows need start+200*64 = 28160 offsets = 112640 bytes against the 77824 fitted. PLAN.md Queue B item 4.
